prompt: Trong các dãy số sau, dãy số nào là dãy số tăng?
solution: Với <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℕ</mi><mo>*</mo></msup></mrow></semantics></math>, xét dãy <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> nên <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></semantics></math> là dãy tăng.
